chunks: What is to come is imminent.

key_terms.الْآزِفَةُ: The closest event (referring to the Day of Resurrection or a major divine occurrence)

ai.seo_question: What does 'Al-Azifah' refer to in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a call to spiritual awakening, with some scholars linking the 'closest event' to the reappearance of Imam al-Mahdi (aj) as the imminent fulfillment of divine promise. It underscores the urgency of moral accountability, reminding believers that the boundary between this world and the Hereafter is thin and ever-nearing.
